name: VP (variance preserving)
plain: Continuous VP-SDE noise schedule from the score-SDE line of work. It takes β parameters rather than a sigma range, so the top and bottom of the schedule come from the formula and not from the model. Node only.
math:
t_i = linspace(1, eps_s, n).
σ_i = √(expm1(β_d·t_i²/2 + β_min·t_i)), then 0.
label: from code
